title: Reusable evidence custody and interchange without a global truth database
claim: A private portfolio evidence-custody implementation may still provide narrow reusable custody/provenance/interchange mechanics without becoming a global truth database, but reuse evaluation is premature. Authenticated private-source review shows the active package repair is truthful at source scope while general installability remains unqualified and the declared cross-platform support contract is currently too broad.
preserved_boundaries: Lantern records do not decide project-specific truth or authority.
promotion_evidence: Authenticated private-source review confirms a bounded package repair removes stale unrelated package metadata, narrows the package/CLI/type-check surface to the custody implementation, removes inherited runtime dependencies, and defines a narrow public API with an explicit no-domain-authority boundary.
A later private consolidation subject carries the same package-repair blobs unchanged.

Independent portability review: source compile, direct import, declared public API symbols, and CLI help PASS, but Windows execution collected 103 tests with 47 PASS / 56 FAIL across checkout-line-ending and POSIX filesystem-primitive portability classes.
Hosted private package workflows are PRE_STEP_NO_EXECUTION, so clean install/test/lint/type/build/import/CLI qualification remains unresolved.
rejection_conditions: Consumers must adopt Lantern-specific domain semantics rather than neutral custody mechanics.
Lantern becomes a mandatory single point of failure.
Interchange loses project-specific provenance or privacy constraints.
A second materially independent real consumer cannot be demonstrated.

critical_objections: The package support contract is operationally broader than the environments in which major custody paths are qualified.
Fail-closed POSIX no-follow behavior is acceptable security posture, but without an explicit platform ceiling it makes the distribution contract misleading.
A line-ending-sensitive frozen benchmark receipt undermines checkout-stable package qualification.
Hosted package CI has not executed steps, so source metadata repair cannot be relabeled as clean package qualification.
No materially independent real consumer has been demonstrated; package readiness must close before reuse economics or semantic neutrality can be tested.

notes: The private implementation identity remains intentionally unpublished by this public repository.
First package task result: SOURCE_REPAIR_PRESENT / PLATFORM_CONTRACT_BLOCKED / CLEAN_INSTALL_UNRESOLVED.
Candidate remains HYPOTHESIS; reuse evaluation is not yet allowed.

Next gate belongs to the private owner lane: either qualify an explicit POSIX platform/filesystem ceiling or implement equivalent safe Windows semantics, make frozen artifacts checkout-stable, and obtain executed clean package qualification.
